FULLY FURNISHED DOUBLE ROOM - BILLS INCLUDED - ENSUITE

Located within walking distance to the town centre, this newly refurbished home is perfect for professionals. Finished to a high standard and ready to move straight into. Property comprises of entrance hallway, shared modern kitchen with oven and hob, washing machine, fridge freezer and wall mounted TV. Each room is fully furnished with a double divan bed, wardrobe, chest of drawers, desk and chair and wall mounted TV, en-suite shower room in each room. Private enclosed yard, on street parking.
